name: io.github.Wavix/mcp
title: Wavix
description: Wavix telecom MCP: SMS, voice, 2FA, SIP, numbers, 10DLC, CDRs. Account sign-in or API key.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional. Bearer token containing the user's Wavix API key, for clients that connect with a key instead of signing in with a Wavix account (OAuth 2.1). Obtain one at https://wavix.com under Administration → API keys.
